tests.assertionTitle: options-flow first stale instant remains unavailable
tests.description: The production builder evaluates ownerState.nowMs plus seven days plus one millisecond.
tests.requiredResult: The result is unavailable, names stale age, and omits every ready-only metric key.
tests.negativeControl: Change the stale offset from seven days plus one millisecond to exactly seven days.
tests.redRequiredSignal: The stale-state assertion fails because exactly seven days remains ready.

tests.assertionTitle: options-flow evidence-clock ready boundaries use owner model
tests.description: The production builder evaluates ownerState.nowMs at age zero and exactly seven days.
tests.requiredResult: Both reads are ready with owner-produced considered, flagged, lean, score, and ranking values.
tests.negativeControl: Change the exact-seven-day fixture to seven days plus one millisecond.
tests.redRequiredSignal: The boundary-ready assertion fails while production keeps the strict greater-than predicate.

tests.description: The complete repository selftest uses all three ownerState.nowMs-derived fixture instants.
tests.requiredResult: The options-flow outcomes do not depend on wall time and a state mismatch cannot dereference unavailable metrics.
tests.negativeControl: Remove the positive explicit asOf value and the ready-state guard from the selftest assertion group.
tests.redRequiredSignal: The options-flow group reproduces clock drift and the secondary unavailable-metric dereference.

tests.description: One repository process reaches the real parser, owner state, production builder, and owner model for all three scenario outcomes.
tests.requiredResult: All three named options-flow scenario assertions pass in one repository process.
tests.negativeControl: Run each existing BUG023_RED_CONTROL value against its named scenario assertion.
tests.redRequiredSignal: Each control produces its one intended options-flow scenario failure.

tests.description: The complete repository command verifies BUG-023 together with every registered repository assertion.
tests.requiredResult: The command exits zero after the separately owned BUG-017, BUG-024, and Feature 031 findings close, with no options-flow regression.
tests.negativeControl: Remove the positive explicit options-flow clock.
tests.redRequiredSignal: The broader command reports the options-flow failure group.

tests.description: The direct production owner path proves the three clock boundaries without executing the modified selftest assertion group.
tests.command: node --input-type=module -e 'import * as refresh from "./scripts/brief-refresh.mjs"; import * as owner from "./scripts/owner-state.mjs"; const page = refresh.loadToolFunctions("options-flow-feed-lab.html", ["parsePagesChain"]); const ownerState = owner.optionsFlowOwnerState(process.cwd(), { parseChain: page.parsePagesChain }); if (!ownerState || !Number.isFinite(ownerState.nowMs)) throw new Error("finite ownerState.nowMs required"); const dayMs = 86_400_000; const at = (offsetMs) => new Date(ownerState.nowMs + offsetMs).toISOString(); const ageZero = refresh.buildOptionsFlowToolRead({ asOf: at(0) }); const boundary = refresh.buildOptionsFlowToolRead({ asOf: at(7 * dayMs) }); const stale = refresh.buildOptionsFlowToolRead({ asOf: at(7 * dayMs + 1) }); const staleReadyKeys = ["tickers", "contractsFlagged", "consideredCount", "callPremium", "putPremium", "lean", "maxScore", "top"].filter((key) => Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(stale.metrics, key)); const passed = ageZero.state === "ready" && boundary.state === "ready" && stale.state === "unavailable" && staleReadyKeys.length === 0; console.log("BUG023_SHARED_HARNESS_CANARY=" + (passed ? "PASS" : "FAIL")); if (!passed) process.exit(1);'
tests.requiredResult: The canary prints BUG023_SHARED_HARNESS_CANARY=PASS before the broad suite runs.
tests.negativeControl: Change the stale canary offset from seven days plus one millisecond to exactly seven days.
